ticket.title: the workspace rollup index is written untracked beside the ticket records, so every reconcile leaves debris a git add -A would commit
ticket.description:
Observed 2026-11-10: runnning ledger-reconcile inside storypole/ left .gaugeblock/storypole/workspace.sqlite untracked in the working tree, so the file is derived state that no ignore rule covers. The harness root solved the same problem in 1eae42e by ignoring its workspace index; a member has no equivalent rule, and an untracked sqlite sitting beside tracked tickets is exactly the debris SP-24 records a careless git add -A committing. Either the workspace view should write inside the same ignored directory as index.sqlite or .gitignore should name it. Acceptance: ledger-reconcile and workspace commands leave no untracked file behind in any member repository.

FIXED AND VERIFIED 2026-11-10. Diagnosed rather than guessed: the generator in store/mod.rs already emits workspace.sqlite, workspace.sqlite-shm and workspace.sqlite-wal, but the committed .gitignore in eleven of twelve stores predates that list and was never regenerated - only the harness root had all three lines. So every member store left the new workspace index untracked after a reconcile, exactly as observed. Eleven stores each carry one commit adding the three lines (chore(storypole): ignore the workspace index beside the store index), and storypole working tree is clean afterwards, which is the acceptance: a reconcile leaves no untracked file behind in any member repository. Chosen fix over moving the file: the index location is shared with the harness root and is correct; the ignore list was simply stale, and regenerating it per store is one line of vocabulary rather than a relocation.
